target_customer: Dairy farmers who pay for collars and a monthly data service
problem: Dairy farms miss heat, illness and theft signals in cows; Cowlar's collar tracks temperature and activity and alerts by text or call.
business_model: Hardware plus subscription data as a service

founders.name: Umer Adnan
previous_startups: Cowlar Design Studio LLC (founder and CEO per YC page)

competitors.name: Silent Herdsman (Afimilk)
competitors.what: Neck collar for monitoring cows, UK
competitors.funding_then: Raised GBP rounds before acquisition (TechCrunch headline)

technical_complexity.rationale: Waterproof collar with six month battery, sensors and analytics, built from Pakistan with a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Hardware was cheap at 69 dollars but large dairy tech firms already sold collars; data could accumulate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Afimilk bought Silent Herdsman in 2016; no source shows action against Cowlar.

market_need_then: Fortune 2016-04 reported about 1000 units sold at 69 dollars plus 3 dollars a month and noted many farmers already use livestock monitoring technology.

identity.mascot_or_character: Cow imagery implied by the Fitbit for cows tagline

branding.community_and_virality: Fortune and Mashable covered the Fitbit for cows angle in 2016.

brand_strength.rationale: The Fitbit for cows line earned Fortune and Mashable coverage in 2016; no merch or fan evidence.

outcome_analysis: Cowlar sold about 1000 collars by April 2016 and joined YC in Winter 2017, with a reported 240 thousand dollars raised across small rounds. YC marks it Inactive, yet company pages and listings still show Cowlar Inc operating through 2026, so there is no shutdown story and the YC status may reflect a changed focus. No cause is public.
notes: CB Insights (single database, seen in snippet) reports 240K over 6 rounds with latest angel round 2017-07-19; only that round is recorded as amounts are unknown, so earlier rounds are missing. Cowlar.com still shows Cowlar Inc with dairy and design studio links, conflicting with Inactive. Silent Herdsman source is from a search result title and not opened; no other competitor sources dated 2016 to 2017 were found. Name origin not stated.
